description: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the MRR@10 metric for various DPR models. The x-axis represents the number of queries used during inference, with a linear scale, ranging from 2 to 8, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents the MRR@10 metric, with a linear scale, ranging from 33.5 to 36.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot displays seven lines, each representing a different DPR model: DPR w/o query (black, solid), DPR w/ gold (yellow, solid), DPR w/ top-1 (green, solid with circle markers), DPR w/ bottom-1 (dark green, dashed with circle markers), DPR w/ random (purple, dashed with circle markers), and DPR w/ curriculum (red, solid and dashed). The lines exhibit varying trends, with DPR w/ top-1 increasing from approximately 35.0 at x=2 to 36.0 at x=8, DPR w/ gold rising from around 33.5 at x=2 to 35.8 at x=8, and DPR w/ curriculum (solid) increasing from about 35.5 at x=2 to 36.2 at x=8, while DPR w/ bottom-1 starts at around 34.5 at x=2, dips to 33.5 at x=3, and then rises to 36.3 at x=5 before stabilizing.
